_note: Settled RTL-name toggles per merged net, by module: measured on randn at a 512-cycle window. READ _how_to_use BEFORE DIVIDING BY THESE. A net is credited to the OUTERMOST module that names it, so a module whose signals are all ports of an enclosing module keeps none of them and gets no factor (null) or an absurdly large one. These are attribution ratios, not a physical names-per-net measurement of each block.
_how_to_use: For a refit, use recount.json key <pattern>.mean.nets_hier directly; it exists for every pattern measured here and needs no factor. To split that total into price classes, take the SHARES from by_block_settled (names, attributed to the module where the net switches) and scale the whole unit by _total -- one factor for the unit. Do NOT divide by_block_settled by the per-module factors below, and do NOT use by_block_hier as a per-block net count: under the hierarchy merge a net is credited to the OUTERMOST module that names it, so the multiplier's share reads 54.8% of by_block_settled but 22.8% of by_block_hier on randn and 0.0% on pow2 and signs. A per-module pass also leaves the 12 unfactored modules undivided (mixing name counts into a net total) and crushes the 7 flagged ones to near zero.
_pattern: randn, card tiles, seeds 1-2, accumulators at 1e3 and 4e5 ops
_total_is: whole-unit settled name toggles / whole-unit merged net toggles: the figure to use

_modules_without_a_factor.reason: the hierarchy merge credits every one of this module's switching nets to an ancestor scope that names it first, so it holds zero merged nets and the ratio is undefined
